verdict.rule: EXP-003 protocol section 5: if EXP-001 rejected H0_j, the EXP-001 result for j is reported as specific to correct specification when, in demand-x0.8 or demand-x1.25, the 95% interval of Delta_{j,c} (vs base-tuned FIX) lies entirely on the opposite side of zero from the EXP-001 point estimate; if EXP-001 did not reject H0_j, this experiment is descriptive only for j.
